appearance_facts.fact: Chart title reads 'Additional Top Stores: Ad Spend vs Sales'.
Y-axis is labeled 'Sales ($ thousands)' with a vertical range of 50 to 190.
X-axis is labeled 'Advertising Spend ($ thousands)' with a horizontal range of 25 to 75.
Five blue circular data points are plotted in a generally ascending diagonal line.
Each point has a text label identifying it as Store 6, Store 7, Store 8, Store 9, or Store 10.
Store 10 is the highest point on the chart, located at approximately x=70 and y=180.
Store 6 is the lowest point on the chart, located at approximately x=30 and y=60.

public_definitions: The task is to 'Review the ad budget dashboard, then submit the approval decision for the budget expansion request.'
The form requires selecting one of three options: 'Hold and request full-store analysis', 'Approve company-wide budget expansion', or 'Reject budget expansion at this time'.
The chart title is 'Additional Top Stores: Ad Spend vs Sales', implying this data represents a subset of stores.
uncertain: The dashboard only shows data for 'Additional Top Stores' (6-10), not the entire company or all stores.
There is no explicit policy or threshold defined in the image for when to approve, hold, or reject the budget.
The relationship between the 'Additional Top Stores' data and the 'company-wide' or 'full-store' options is not explicitly defined.
